QUOTE: ".yaml` `.yml` `.json` | `path` row only | Findable by name in `search(corpus='files')`. Zero symbols, by design." and "Shell and CMake get real definition rows, when the grammar is present. YAML and JSON get a file-set entry and nothing else."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says YAML/JSON are registered as file-set path rows with zero symbols, while shell/CMake get definition rows, so the two groups are treated differently.
